name: Progress photo note field
evidence: progress.html photoSheet: an editable Note field on the opened photo, written to lk_progressPhotos as it is typed. Drove it: seeded note reads back, an edit survives a reload.

name: Analysis result panels (summary / composition / observations / strengths / focus / qualifier)
gap: The six result panels (summary, composition, observations, strengths, focus, qualifier) cannot be computed on the device: they are a model reading a photograph. The local half is built — the consent step says exactly what would leave the phone, and after it the panel is drawn with each result named and empty, labelled “Needs the server”. What remains: the analysis endpoint, and a reply shape to fill those six panels.
evidence: progress.html analysisPanel()/consentSheet(). Drove it: nothing is sent, nothing is claimed.

name: Weak point → prescription cards
gap: Weak-point prescription cards are the Focus panel's payload. Named at the point of use with what each card would carry (the lifts, the weekly sets); nothing is fabricated. What remains: the analysis endpoint that identifies the weak point and prescribes for it.
evidence: progress.html analysisPanel(). Drove it.

name: "ADD TO SPLIT" from a weak point
gap: ADD TO SPLIT belongs to a weak-point card, so it cannot exist before one does. Stated at the point of use — it writes into your split, and only appears once there is an analysis behind it. What remains: the analysis endpoint; the split write itself is local and already exists in split-builder.
evidence: progress.html analysisPanel(). Drove it.

name: "Tap a photo → Analyse Physique" hint banner
evidence: progress.html photosSheet: a banner above the grid saying a photo opens, and that from there you can note it, compare it, or ask for an analysis. Drove it.

name: Workout detail (edit / delete / convert to split) from Home
gap: Convert to split stays cut, with the reason recorded in workout-detail.html:40.
evidence: Drove the whole path: Home/Train hands the id over in lk_openWorkout, the session opens, Edit opens the editor, Delete removes it from lk_history, Repeat reloads it into the log.

name: Goals list (active + completed)
evidence: progress.html goalsSheet(): Active and Completed sections, every row a tap target that opens the goal, a bar per row, and an empty state. Drove it: completing a goal moves it to Completed and the screen's Goals row counts the active ones.

name: Create / edit a goal
evidence: Create unchanged; Edit reopens the same form over the goal's own figures (type and lift fixed, since the type is what measures it) and Delete asks twice. Drove it: an edit rewrites lk_goals and the ring recomputes; delete removes the row.

name: Goal detail view (ring, start/current/target, deadline, notes)
evidence: progress.html goalDetailSheet(): ring, start/now/target tiles, deadline chip with days left or days past, what measures it, editable notes written to lk_goals, Mark complete / Reopen, Edit, Delete. Drove every one; figures reproduce from the seed (bench 60→72.5 of 75 = 83%).

name: AI goal progress analysis
gap: The whole local half is built: an Analyse my progress control on the goal, a consent step naming exactly what would be sent (the goal's start, target, deadline, the log it is measured against and the session dates) and what would come back (a rate, whether it reaches the target, what to change). Sending says plainly that nothing left the device. What remains: the analysis endpoint.
evidence: progress.html goalConsentSheet(). Drove it.

name: AI body fat estimate
gap: Built local half: an “Estimate it from a photo” control in the body-fat log, a consent step saying what would be sent and that a photo estimate is worse than the calipers, scale or DEXA the log already takes, and an honest refusal on send. What remains: the estimate endpoint.
evidence: progress.html bfConsentSheet(). Drove it.

name: Beta activity telemetry from Goals
gap: There is still no telemetry layer anywhere in the build, and no shipped key holds one — inventing a queue key here would be inventing the schema the sync layer has to own. What remains: the beta activity endpoint and the queue that feeds it, at cutover. The build now says so where it matters: the goal consent sheet states that this build keeps no activity log and sends no usage data.
evidence: progress.html goalConsentSheet().

name: Workout lifecycle in the root
gap: The local lifecycle is complete and was driven end to end: start (Home/Train/Repeat) → log → Finish → Review → Save → lk_history → workout-detail, with the record set in the session carried through to Review and into the saved row. Identity is stamped on the way in (withWorkoutIds) and a second save cannot double a session (sameWorkout). What remains is the half that is a server by definition: post-save sync and the activity log.
evidence: Drove the whole loop; see F-TRAIN-022.

name: Weight log & refeed trigger
gap: The Progress half is done and was driven: one weigh-in a day, per-entry deltas, a weekly rate measured over the span rather than the entry count, and the weigh-in also patches lk_profile.weightKg. The refeed trigger and its dismissal live in fuel.html, which this package does not own — reading it, the dismissal is now persisted (lk_fuelRefeedNo with an `until` date) rather than held in page memory, so the stated gap looks closed by the fuel package; it needs that package to confirm it and to say whether lk_fuelRefeedNo or v6's lk_refeedDismissed is the key to keep.
evidence: Drove the Progress half. fuel.html not touched.

name: Workout identity helpers (`withWorkoutIds`, `sameWorkout`)
gap: The pair lives in review.html, the screen that writes history. Its right home is store.js, which every screen loads and this package does not own — the shared-module owner should lift it there and have train.html call it.
evidence: review.html withWorkoutIds()/sameWorkout(). Drove it: every row in lk_history carries an id after a save, including any that arrived without one, and pressing Save twice writes one row.

name: Mark a set done (✓) — with haptics, pop animation, PR check and rest start
evidence: workout-log.html: navigator.vibrate on the tick (one pulse) and on a record (three), guarded for browsers without it, and a 220ms pop on the control that was pressed, switched off under prefers-reduced-motion. Drove it with navigator.vibrate spied: [12] then [12,60,24].

name: Cycle set type: Normal → Warm-up → Drop
evidence: Cycling a set to Drop now fills it at three quarters of the set above it, rounded to the half, and only into a row nobody has typed into or logged. The fourth state (to failure) is kept deliberately, with the reason written at SET_KINDS. Drove it: an empty row under a 40 kg set fills at 30; a typed 75 is never overwritten.

name: Per-row unit override (kg ⇄ lb for one exercise)
evidence: The exercise sheet's unit control now sets a per-lift override kept in lk_exEquip; the tools menu keeps the app-wide switch. The column head, the cells, the pad, the plate toast, the AI suggestion and the PR text all read that lift's unit; the model stays kilograms. Drove it: 72.5 kg reads 159.8 lb on that card alone, 165 lb typed stores as 74.84 kg, and it survives a reload.

name: PR detection during a session + ALL-TIME PR banner
evidence: The record is written on the set, so it outlives the toast: an ALL-TIME PR band at the top of the log for the life of the session, a PR badge on the card, and the mark it beat carried into Review. Drove it: banner still there after the toast expires and after a reload; reopening the set withdraws the claim.

name: Custom rest duration (m + s)
evidence: Minutes and seconds, both seeded from the current target, validated 5 seconds to 15 minutes, and a rest already running takes the new length. Drove it: 2:30 stores 150; 0:02 is refused.

name: Hold-to-open exercise action sheet
evidence: 450ms press-and-hold on the exercise name, with a squeeze while held, a haptic when it fires, and a guard that it can only start on .exc__main itself. A short tap says how to open it instead of opening it; Enter and Space open it outright for a keyboard. The first successful hold writes lk_holdTipSeen, which is what the on-screen tip is gated on. Drove all of it.

name: Post-workout Throwback card (1-in-5)
evidence: review.html: a throwback card between the comparison and the sets. The 1-in-5 roll is a hash of the session being reviewed rather than Math.random, so the same session always decides the same way and it can be asserted in a test; it only draws when a lift in this session was also trained 30+ days ago and has gone up. Hide writes lk_throwbackDismissed, the shipped key, and nothing asks for three days. Drove it: Jul 30's 60 kg x 7 against today's 72.5 kg x 8, +12.5 kg. Note: the seed sets lk_throwbackDismissed to 2026-09-08, so with the seed loaded it is correctly suppressed.

name: Add Featured Lift search screen
evidence: lk_featuredLifts is read (it decides which lift the screen opens on — the old code claimed that in a comment and used a literal 111), shown as a strip of one-tap chips above the chart, and written by a Feature it / Featured control on the trend card. Both shapes of the key are read; the shipped shape is written. Drove it: featuring and un-featuring write the key and survive a reload.

name: PR detail — three summary cards (1RM / Working / Estimated)
evidence: A per-lift record screen behind the trend card: heaviest, best working set at 6–8 and estimated 1RM as three cards, a sentence saying what each one means, and every record for that lift with its date and its own estimate. Drove it: both seeded bench records listed.

name: Est-1RM progression chart with 30D / 90D / ALL range filter
gap: Kept cut. On this history 90D and ALL are the same data, so a third range is a control that changes nothing; the reason is recorded in progress.html's own header comment and beside RANGES.
evidence: Drove both ranges: 4 weeks and 12 weeks return different point counts and different date domains.
